summary: Your twentieth Sunday review and the end of Module 12. You answer 9 questions on reliability, caches, votes, SLIs, SLOs and the dashboard with a confidence number, write the module retrospective (including what is estimated, example or stand-in in your numbers), set a weekly routine of three to five applications, extend your glossary, count how hard your system is to start, tag week 20 and plan week 21.
goal: M12 retrospective; job search: 3-5 applications a week.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Write the Module 12 retrospective, 2 lines for each of 5 questions
Write your five sentences for applications and look for a pattern in the log
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Start all four parts from your README and count the terminals and the commands
Run git tag week-20, then plan week 21 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 3 to 5 applications
Play the Module 12 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
